nodes.label: Render env vars (Supabase, VAPID, BUS_API_KEY)
nodes.rationale: Secrets marked sync:false so they are entered in Render, never committed

nodes.label: HTTPS with verified CA (API_CA_CERT)
nodes.rationale: Without HTTPS the API key travels in plaintext; without CA verification server can be impersonated

nodes.label: CI server smoke test
nodes.rationale: Starts server without SUPABASE_URL (in-memory mode) and curls /api/rutas, /api/config and / — same routes Render and the browser use

nodes.label: CI syntax check (node --check)
nodes.rationale: Minimal lint: Node checks syntax of every src/tools/public JS file without executing it

nodes.label: Auto-deploy only when CI passes
nodes.rationale: autoDeployTrigger: checksPass deploys each push to main only if GitHub CI passes

nodes.label: OBD-II over CAN (SN65HVD230)
nodes.rationale: Verify CAN 11-bit 500kbps with ELM327 first; wrong speed injects errors into the vehicle network

nodes.label: Adaptive send interval (5s/30s/60s/10min)
nodes.rationale: Send less when stopped or parked to save mobile data; merge engine data with position

nodes.label: Mobile data usage budget (~180-230 MB/month)
nodes.rationale: HTTP headers/TCP dominate ~150B JSON; 30-50MB goal unreachable with current API

nodes.label: Offline queue in flash (LittleFS)
nodes.rationale: Messages stored with GPS ts in flash (~300KB, ~3h) survive power loss in tunnels/no coverage; oldest half dropped when full

nodes.label: Proposed backend changes (keepAlive, batch endpoint, MQTT, heading)
nodes.norm_label: proposed backend changes (keepalive, batch endpoint, mqtt, heading)
nodes.rationale: keepAliveTimeout 65s avoids repeated TLS handshake; batch endpoint ~60-80MB/mo; MQTT ~40-50MB/mo; use real heading/speed in app.js and eta.js. Not applied.
